desc: Implement the best-first heap enumeration over sorted descending arrays using encoded states and duplicate suppression.
Prove that coordinate-wise monotonicity makes the heap frontier enumerate triples in globally nonincreasing order.
Check heap/visited memory and runtime at \(K=5\times10^5\), optimizing state representation if necessary.
Verify the implementation on all provided samples and boundary cases such as \(N=1\), \(K=1\), and equal values.
Produce the final stdin/stdout Python solution with correct integer handling.
